category_edits.rationale: Add a fixed 0.2 residual connection from the GRU input embedding to each recurrent output, preserving item identity before the existing readout and scoring. Embedding and recurrent dimensions already match. The generated predictor dynamically imports GRU4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically uses the same architecture without additional writer changes.

edits.replace:
def encode(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + 0.2 * emb

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):

        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
        out = out + 0.2 * emb
